claims.claim: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1.1 with new voices in French, German, Hindi, Mexican Spanish, Korean, and Japanese that include better accents and less checking.
claims.supporting_quote: New voices. Better accents. And less "checking..." GPT-Live-1.1 brings these updates to Voice in ChatGPT, Codex, and dots, with new voices in French, German, Hindi, Mexican Spanish, Korean, and Japanese.
